## The 5 checks

| Check | What it asserts |
|---|---|
| `ltv_by_archetype_monotone` | mean e_ltv falls whale > engaged spender > casual > time filler > inactive |
| `relevance_lifts_ctr` | CTR is higher on high-relevance rows |
| `format_ecpm_ordering` | banner < interstitial < rewarded |
| `adverse_selection` | lost rows are worth more than won rows, which is the selection C1 suffers |
| `win_rises_with_bid_within_format` | bidding more wins more, held within each format |

## Verdict

**PASS**
